name: Sauveur Rouge
source:
Devils live in "Cocutus", and angels live in "Eden". After the war the "Tower of condemnation" was built by the Red savior to execute those who pass border between the two races.
Tower is inhabited by a guilty person with red wings who is believed to be reincarnation of the savior.
Executions repeat in this tower every day. Until that day...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
恶魔生活在“科库托斯”，天使生活在“伊甸”。战争结束后，红色救世主建造了“审判之塔”，处决那些跨越两个种族边界的人。

塔中居住着一个长着红色翅膀的罪人，人们相信他是救世主的转世。

处刑每天都在这座塔中重复。

直到那一天……

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
